# PandaDoc

PandaDoc offers document creation, e-signatures, and workflow automation, helping sales teams and businesses streamline proposals, contracts, and agreement processes

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/pandadoc/.

## Actions

- **Create Contact**: This tool creates a new contact in pandadoc.
- **Create Document Attachment**: Creates and adds an attachment to a pandadoc document.
- **Create Document Folder**: Creates a new folder in pandadoc to organize documents.
- **Create Document from File Upload**: Creates a new document in pandadoc by uploading a file (pdf, docx, etc.).
- **Create PandaDoc Webhook**: Creates a new webhook subscription in pandadoc to receive notifications about specific events.
- **Create Template**: This tool allows users to create a new template in pandadoc from a pdf file or from scratch.
- **Delete Contact**: This tool allows you to delete a contact from your pandadoc account.
- **Delete Template**: This tool deletes a specific template from pandadoc.
- **List Contacts** (read-only): A tool to list and search contacts in pandadoc.
- **List Document Folders** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all document folders in pandadoc.
- **List Templates** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all templates available in the pandadoc account.
- **Move Document to Folder**: This tool allows users to move a document to a specific folder within their pandadoc account.
- **Create or Update Contact**: This tool creates a new contact or updates an existing one in pandadoc based on the email address.
- **Get Template Details** (read-only): This tool retrieves detailed information about a specific template by its id.
